reason: This plugin is primarily a usage/quotа monitoring utility for DSH sessions, exposing spend status in the chat UI and enforcing budget-aware behavior by blocking additional calls when configured limits are hit, based on per-session token accounting and pricing rules defined in the README and plugin manifest.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DSH 会话提供额度监控与计费展示，在界面上显示实时消耗进度，并在额度耗尽时拦截后续模型调用。
summaries.en: This plugin provides per-session quota monitoring for DSH, showing live budget usage in the UI and preventing additional model calls when the configured limit is reached.

capabilities: Tracks per-session model usage and spending from DSH token usage events and persists session ledger data
Displays a live quota progress indicator and cost deduction feedback in the web client UI
Automatically intercepts/blocks model invocations when configured quota is exhausted
Supports configurable model pricing and peak/off-peak tariff settings for billing calculations

reasons.code: README: lists budget blocking via `agent/pre-step` to reject new model calls when quota is exhausted
README: describes real-token billing, live progress bar, per-session accounting, and persisted ledger storage
